prompt: rgb.jpg is a horizontal strip of 5 frames, left to right in time order, sampled from the few seconds of a head-mounted (egocentric) video; the camera wearer is the viewpoint. Describe the spatial understanding this image supports: the layout of the scene; which people and objects are present and roughly how far each is from the camera wearer (in metres) and from each other; relative positions (left/right/in front/behind, above/below); which way people face and whether they look toward the camera wearer; what is within arm's reach of the camera wearer or of others; occlusions and anything partly out of view; and how these change across the 5 frames (approach, retreat, turning). Describe only spatial facts. Do not guess anyone's intentions, social norms, or what anyone should do. Return only JSON: {"rgb": "..."} with 4-6 sentences.

descriptions.rgb: A rough gray concrete wall or slab fills most of the upper foreground, roughly 0.2–1 m from the camera, while a narrow construction platform with metal pipes, rebar, wooden supports, and wet concrete extends below and ahead by about 1–5 m. A worker appears near the far-left edge in the first frame, about 4–6 m away and partly cut off, standing above the platform and facing generally right rather than directly toward the camera. Another distant worker is intermittently visible near the upper-right area in later frames, about 4–6 m away, partly obscured by the concrete edge and scaffolding, with no clear indication that they look toward the camera wearer. The nearest pipes, wall edge, and supporting poles are within about 0.5–1.5 m of the wearer, whereas scattered buckets, sacks, boards, and other materials lie farther ahead around 2–5 m away and generally several metres from the workers. Across the five frames, the viewpoint shifts rightward along the wall, causing the left worker to leave view, exposing more of the platform and materials, and bringing the right-side worker briefly into clearer view; the large concrete surface continuously occludes much of the area above and ahead.
